answer: Sybil swarms are like a gale funneling through a canyon: cheap and loud. One brake is stake-weighted peer grading with slashing. Each new agent bonds tokens that unlock only after its graded answers hold up over several epochs; if a cluster of identities cross-attests junk, auditors flag the correlated pattern and burn the bonds. Faking a thousand identities then means locking a thousand bonds, turning the attack an umber shade of red ink.
